### Bible Pathway - August 25
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-25-2013.html
Passage: Jeremiah 37:16-17
Points:
- King Zedekiah secretly questioned Jeremiah to ask whether God had spoken.
- Jeremiah remained faithful under hardship, confirming God's warning of impending captivity.
- Scripture provides God's inspired message to instruct, correct, and guide humanity today.
- While many people discard biblical truth as outdated, Christians must embrace the full Bible.
- God's Word reveals human sin and points people toward salvation in Jesus Christ.
